[quote=Carver]I am no feline Georgia! You [u]are[/u] I are alike, me and you. You and me. We complete each other.[/quote]

notes.title: Shocking Trivia + Random News
notes.notes:
First for something that might shake your entire worldview, you might never see things the same after this so fortify your minds now.

Ready? Ok... You know the part when you get to the village and meet this elephant?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42726885/b0c52a90e011ed0d89781fc8b1cd628c1d2a0edf.png[/img]

You were probably thinking when you saw the character: “Why is this just a realistic photograph of an elephant and not a drawing like everyone else? This is kind of odd but I guess I'll forget it and continue to focus on the thought-provoking narrative.”

Well here is the shocking trivia, [u]this is actually [b]not[/b] a real photo of an elephant[/u]. It too is a drawing, a mere illustration.

No really it's actually true, there is the one tiny hint to show it's a fake, look closely at it's toes here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42726885/81191533c7b8d9160ca1a6a66d3c0b4c36904c55.png[/img]

See, it only has two toes (2), real elephants have five (5). So there ya go, not an actual photo of an elephant.

Now that you know the truth, try to keep this information on the down-low, not everyone is prepared for something of this caliber.

Anyway, spooky themed game about to drop just in time for Halloween, wishlist it here:

notes.title: Current Power Levels, Fighting Styles + Alignment Chart
notes.notes:
This has spoilers so if you haven't played the game yet turn back, play it (including the after credits scene), then return.

GOT IT?

Here's the current power level ranking from strongest to weakest:

1: Beethoven
2: The Night Gale
3: Teddy [i]*when a certain condition is met[/i]
4: Bonny
5: Mozart
6: Georgia
7: The Carver
8: Teddy [i]*normal state[/i]
9: Janus

Teddy's “certain condition” is a mystery. Mozart was one step below Georgia in the beginning but after the post-credit scene she's now stronger.

Fighting styles of the characters, using RPG terms:

[b]Georgia [/b]– Melee Warrior, uses a hatchet/axe thing
[b]Mozart [/b]– Caster/Summoner, wields forbidden musical magic
[b]Bonny [/b]– Monk, uses punches and kicks (and headbutts)

Everyone else is a secret.

And finally a somewhat accurate alignment chart based on the story so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42726885/7a8da8089f1f884b5bebf13b8e8463e49c72b65c.png[/img]

notes.title: What if George Washington was a Girl? Is out now! It's free too!
notes.notes:
What if George Washington was a Girl? is out. You follow Georgia Washington in historically accurate events like fighting Mozart, dealing with her job as a Templar for the United Nations and investigating a small village about a villain known as the Carver.

This also uses a beta version of a custom made visual novel engine, if you're into visual novels leave feedback on it and if any features are missing, here's some of what's already planned:

[list]
[*]Different routes (endings)
[*]Phone/Tablet support
[*]Naming certain characters
[*]Animated Sprites and Backgrounds?
[/list]
